project_name: GRR-01 Reference Project (Part A - physical infrastructure)
notes: Rolling stock of the GRR-01 reference railway, kept in a companion file.

examples/GRR-01.json stays frozen and declares no rolling stock of its own (rolling_stock.vehicles == []); this file is data of its own document_kind and changes no key, value, count or rule of the frozen project.

RS-HSR320 carries the high-speed reference assumptions (data_status REFERENCE_ASSUMPTION); RS-REG200 is the synthetic regional reference (data_status SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE). Neither is manufacturer data.

Neither stock type declares a tractive-effort characteristic: the simplified FORCE_THEN_POWER_LIMITED description (rated power and maximum effort) is the delivered one. The optional traction_curve is modelled and validated for a later stage.

The running-resistance description stores the model name, the three coefficients, the coefficient speed unit and the output force unit. Stage 6A stores these values and computes no force; the curve-resistance term is declared to come from the project's stored geometry (model_source PROJECT_DYNAMICS) and is not stored per stock type.

The braking and ETCS supervision entries are stored reference decelerations used to describe the stock type; no braking curve, supervision curve or motion of any kind is computed from them in this stage.
Physical validity of every value below is checked by railway_headway_sim.validation.rolling_stock_validation; an invalid definition is reported and refused, never repaired.
